1. Open Android Auto settings on the phone.
2. Scroll to Version and tap it about ten times to unlock developer mode.
3. Open the three-dot menu, choose Developer settings and turn on Unknown sources.
4. Tap Allow speed detection above and accept the prompts.
5. Connect to the car. Car Video appears in the app list on the car screen. If it is missing, open Customise launcher in Android Auto settings and tick it.
